name: Qloo
description: Taste and cultural intelligence API over a knowledge graph of entities, tags and places: recommendations, audience insights and trends for agents, with a local MCP server and CLI.

skills.name: Recommend from Taste
skills.description: Find restaurants, films, music, brands and places related to a taste profile built from entities, tags and locations.

skills.name: Rank Options by Taste
skills.description: Rank a set of options you provide, such as hotel brands or venues, against a shared audience taste profile.

skills.name: Compare Audiences
skills.description: Compare the audiences of two groups of entities and return the tags and aggregate demographics that characterize them.

skills.name: Explore Popularity Trends
skills.description: Get popularity trends for up to five entities over a date range and find geographic areas where an entity is popular.
